definitions.explanation: The act of returning something damaged or deteriorated to its original or proper condition. Used for physical objects, buildings, artwork, and abstract things like relationships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修復|しゅうふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{修復|しゅうふく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Repair work on the damaged bridge has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国宝|こくほう}→国宝：09642_kokuhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵画|かいが}→絵画：02597_kaiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修復|しゅうふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Restoring a national treasure painting requires advanced skills and a long time.

notes:
Can be used for both physical repairs (buildings, artwork, infrastructure) and figurative restoration (relationships, trust, reputation). Compared to ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧ (repair), {修復|しゅうふく} implies restoring something closer to its original state and is often used for more significant or delicate work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修復|しゅうふく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (repair/restoration work)
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{修復|しゅうふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (mend a relationship)
- {修復|しゅうふく}⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧ (beyond repair)
- ⟦{文化財|ぶんかざい}→文化財：12932_bunkazai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{修復|しゅうふく} (restoration of cultural property)
